Worked directly with clients to gather business requirements, manage server updates, and deliver production features.
Implemented and maintained web application authentication and authorization features.
Deployed and maintained production builds utilizing Vercel orchestration.
Improved modular UI components for cross-device responsiveness and usability.
Investigated, debugged, and resolved production application performance issues.
Assisted in building and maintaining software systems using Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
Implemented clean backend endpoints connected to MongoDB to run CRUD operations.
Supported cloud architectural integrations using AWS S3 for object asset storage uploads.
